image_description: A close-up, top-down view of a Dungeness crab (Cancer magister) lying on dark, wet sand mixed with shell fragments. The crab is oriented vertically with its head at the top. The ventral side (underside) is partially visible due to the angle, showing the folded abdomen and leg attachments. The carapace is broad and oval, colored in mottled shades of beige, tan, and reddish-brown. The large claws (chelipeds) are prominent, with dark tips and robust structures. Several walking legs extend laterally. The texture appears hard and calcified, consistent with a crustacean exoskeleton.
